title: Understanding ABS vs PVC in DWV Systems
description: Selecting the correct piping material is fundamental for reliable drain, waste, and vent systems. ABS and Schedule 40 PVC are two widely used thermoplastic materials in residential drainage. ABS is a black, single-step solvent-welded pipe valued for high impact resistance in cold ambient temperatures. White PVC requires a two-step installation process using primer and solvent cement, offering excellent rigid structural stability and chemical resistance. Interchanging or directly solvent-welding ABS to PVC with standard cement is generally restricted by code due to thermal expansion differences. Always check local code approvals for material selection.
